ci_support_linux_64_channel_sourcesconda:
c_compiler:
- gcc
c_compiler_version:
- '15'
c_stdlib:
- sysroot
c_stdlib_version:
- '2.17'
channel_sources:
- conda-forge,conda-forge/label/python_rc
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
numpy:
- '2'
pin_run_as_build:
  python:
    min_pin: x.x
    max_pin: x.x
python:
- 3.15.* *_cp315
target_platform:
- linux-64
zip_keys:
- - python
  - channel_sources
name: astropy-healpix
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: astropy-healpix
  version: "2.0.1"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/${{ name | replace('-', '_') }}-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 0e3f1c94064c45da779900cb90c938df7aef99a924abb23eeb893b16540e77e6

build:
  number: 2
  skip: match(python, "<3.10")
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv

requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - numpy
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
  host:
    - python
    - pip
    - numpy
    - setuptools
    - setuptools_scm
    - extension-helpers
    - wheel
  run:
    - python
    - astropy-base >=6.1
    - numpy >=2

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - astropy_healpix
      pip_check: false
  - requirements:
      run:
        - hypothesis
        - pytest-astropy
    script:
      - pytest --pyargs astropy_healpix

about:
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_file: LICENSE.md
  summary: BSD-licensed HEALPix for Astropy
  description: BSD-licensed HEALPix for Astropy
  homepage: http://github.com/astropy/astropy-healpix
  repository: https://github.com/astropy/astropy-healpix
  documentation: https://astropy-healpix.readthedocs.io

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - lpsinger
    - beckermr
    - astrofrog
